## Webhook → compliant e-invoice PDF

POST an invoice to this webhook and get back a hybrid **ZUGFeRD / Factur-X** PDF/A-3 (human-readable PDF + embedded EN 16931 XML).

Expected body:
```
{ "invoice": { "number": "INV-1", "issueDate": "2026-01-31", "dueDate": "2026-03-02", "currencyCode": "EUR", "seller": { ... }, "buyer": { ... }, "lines": [ ... ], "totalNetAmount": 20, "totalTaxAmount": 3.8, "totalGrossAmount": 23.8, "paymentTerms": "Net 30" } }
```

1. Add your **PolyDoc API** credential.
2. Full invoice schema: https://docs.polydoc.tech

Note: PolyDoc generates the compliant document. Transmission (Peppol), archiving and tax-authority reporting are separate.

Start free: https://polydoc.tech/?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=template&utm_campaign=einvoice
